verdict.summary: Both prior findings are resolved in this revision. Line 77 defines established_upper once as the minimum of the valid acknowledgement, authenticated publication-upper and verified-witness bounds; lines 57, 79, 87 and 89 route prospective evidence, replay evidence, normalization and as-of export through that single value with acknowledgement existence still mandatory; line 81 pins explicit per-consumer outcomes for the date-only, DST-ambiguous, late-acknowledgement and missing-acknowledgement cases; and line 73 now names the outcome-availability lower boundary as the earliest official print for the same series/period rather than the resolving vintage. Boundary strictness remains consistent (inclusive <= for data/as-of filters, strict < for cohort receipt, dispatch, witness and outcome ordering), the record-level inclusive filter in prospective mode is dominated by the strict bundle-freeze < cohort-witness < cutoff chain so no admission gap exists, and the acyclic task/experiment graph, cohort-proof commitment before dispatch, reconciliation, proxy, packaging and PostgreSQL CI requirements are unchanged from the previously agreed text. Only read-only file access was available: the review directory contains solely artifact.snapshot, and the supplied byte count and SHA-256 are copied as supplied rather than independently recomputed. No actionable defect remains at the plan level; residual risk moves to implementation fidelity, which the plan itself routes to independent code review and the enumerated acceptance tests.
